entries.title: I John 4:1
segments: ¶Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God; because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

entries.title: I John 4:2
segments: By this you know the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

entries.title: I John 4:3
segments: and every spirit that does not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God. And this is the [spirit] of the Antichrist, which you have heard was coming, and is now already in the world.

entries.title: I John 4:4
segments: ¶You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.

entries.title: I John 4:5
segments: They are of the world. Therefore they speak [as] of the world, and the world hears them.

entries.title: I John 4:6
segments: We are of God. He who knows God hears us; he who is not of God does not hear us. By this we know the spirit of truth and the spirit of error.

entries.title: I John 4:7
segments: ¶Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves is born of God and knows God.

entries.title: I John 4:8
segments: He who does not love does not know God, for God is love.

entries.title: I John 4:9
segments: In this the love of God was manifested toward us, that God has sent His only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through Him.

entries.title: I John 4:10
segments: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that He loved us and sent His Son [to be] the propitiation for our sins.

entries.title: I John 4:11
segments: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

entries.title: I John 4:12
segments: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God abides in us, and His love has been perfected in us.

entries.title: I John 4:13
segments: By this we know that we abide in Him, and He in us, because He has given us of His Spirit.

entries.title: I John 4:14
segments: ¶And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son [as] Savior of the world.

entries.title: I John 4:15
segments: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God abides in him, and he in God.

entries.title: I John 4:16
segments: And we have known and believed the love that God has for us. God is love, and he who abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

entries.title: I John 4:17
segments: ¶Love has been perfected among us in this: that we may have boldness in the day of judgment; because as He is, so are we in this world.

entries.title: I John 4:18
segments: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear involves torment. But he who fears has not been made perfect in love.

entries.title: I John 4:19
segments: We love Him because He first loved us.

entries.title: I John 4:20
segments: If someone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

entries.title: I John 4:21
segments: And this commandment we have from Him: that he who loves God [must] love his brother also.
